title: Pad Warranty Terms of the Brake Service Warranties Lines
content:
## Term of the pad warranty

Under Brake Service Warranties, the pad warranty of a brake job runs for the line's warranty months, counted in calendar months from the date of the original repair order, and for the line's warranty miles, counted from the odometer on that repair order. A figure of 0 means no month limit, or no mile limit, for lifetime pads.

| Brake service line | Warranty months | Warranty miles | What the pad warranty covers | Lifetime pads |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | 12 | 12000 | defects only | No |
| Crestline Standard Brake Service 24-Month/24,000-Mile Warranty | 24 | 24000 | defects only | No |
| Crestline Ceramic Brake Service 36-Month/36,000-Mile Warranty | 36 | 36000 | defects and wear | No |
| Crestline Premium Ceramic Lifetime Pad Warranty | 0 (no month limit) | 0 (no mile limit) | defects and wear | Yes |
| Crestline Complete Brake Service Lifetime Pad Warranty | 0 (no month limit) | 0 (no mile limit) | defects and wear | Yes |
| Crestline Severe-Duty Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | 12 | 12000 | defects only | No |

## What each coverage type means

- **Defects only** — the pad warranty covers defects.
- **Defects and wear** — the pad warranty covers defects, and the pads are also replaced when worn to minimum.
- **Lifetime pads** — the pads are replaced for wear for as long as the purchaser owns the vehicle.

## Terms common to every line

| Term | Every line |
|---|---|
| Warranty follows the vehicle to a new owner | No |
| Warranty ends when the purchaser no longer owns the vehicle | Yes |
| Pads installed under warranty keep the original job's warranty dates | Yes |
| How the original job is proven | the repair order on file |
| Where warranty work may be done | any Crestline store |

## Questions the terms answer

**Does a pad warranty pass to the buyer of the vehicle?** No. On every line the warranty is not transferable, and it ends when the purchaser no longer owns the vehicle.

**Do replacement pads start a fresh warranty term?** No. Pads installed under warranty keep the original job's warranty dates on every line.

**Which lines carry a month and mile limit?** The Value, Standard, Ceramic and Severe-Duty lines. The Crestline Premium Ceramic Lifetime Pad Warranty and the Crestline Complete Brake Service Lifetime Pad Warranty carry 0 months and 0 miles, meaning neither limit applies to their lifetime pads.
